title: At the Cafe
text:
Tom is at a cafe. He wants a coffee. He says, "Hello, can I have a coffee, please?" The woman says, "Yes, here you are." Tom says, "Thank you!"

Now Tom is happy. The coffee is hot. He sits at a small table. Ana is his friend, and she says, "Hi, Tom!"

questions.text: What can we guess about the woman who gave Tom the coffee?

vocabulary.definition: a small place where you can buy coffee and food
a hot drink made from roasted beans
a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs
a person you know well and like

paragraph_translations: Tom está em uma cafeteria. Ele quer um café. Ele diz: "Olá, posso tomar um café, por favor?" A mulher diz: "Sim, aqui está." Tom diz: "Obrigado!"
Agora Tom está feliz. O café está quente. Ele senta em uma mesa pequena. Ana é sua amiga, e ela diz: "Oi, Tom!"
